newsitem.title: UK: Stg hit as Labour victory prompts profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Stg hit as Labour victory prompts profit-taking.

text.p: The pound got battered in European morning trading on Friday as dealers took profits and trimmed long positions in the wake of the Labour Party's sweeping victory in the British elections. The pound shed over three pfennigs from pre-election result levels and was down two cents against the dollar. "Sterling has been very strong going into the election, and the big Labour victory will give policy-makers a free hand," said Tony Norfield, treasury economist at ABN Amro in London.
